metadata.title: OSS Radar — what's rising in open source
metadata.description: See which GitHub open-source projects and libraries are gaining momentum in frontend, backend, DevOps, mobile, data and security. Updated daily.

theme.toggle: Switch between light and dark theme

footer.text: Data comes from the GitHub API and is refreshed daily. Monthly reports are written by Claude.

grades.formula: Activity score = (commits × 3 + merged PRs × 2 + closed issues) ÷ ln(stars + 1), over the last 30 days.

home.title: What's rising in {domain}
home.intro: Repositories plotted by popularity and recent activity, plus the libraries they use that are growing fastest this month.

radar.title: Stars × activity
radar.description: Each dot is a repository. The further right, the more stars. The higher, the more commits, merged PRs and closed issues in the last 30 days.

rising.title: Fastest-growing libraries
rising.description: Used by more {domain} repositories than last month ({month}).
rising.empty: Nothing has grown this month yet. Check back after the next crawl.

report.title: Latest report
